_help: The voice-over of promo v2 (voice af_heart). 'text' is what is spoken (numbers and keys spelled the way the voice should say them), 'caption' is what the subtitle shows (default: text). 'short' is the line used in the 9:16 and 1:1 videos (30 s at most). Edit and run: make-demo.ps1 -Steps v2.

where.text: Every time you paste text into an online translator, it leaves your computer.
where.short: Online translators send your text away.

offline.text: Meet Owl-L. It translates right on your PC. No internet, no account, no subscription.
offline.short: Owl-L translates on your PC. No internet needed.

meeting.text: In a meeting in another language? Turn on captions, and Owl-L translates them live, speaker by speaker.

capture.text: Can't copy the text? Just draw a box: images, videos, games.
capture.short: Or any text on your screen.

popup.text: Select text anywhere and press Control C twice.
popup.caption: Select text anywhere and press Ctrl+C twice.

docs.text: Translate Word, PowerPoint and Excel files, and keep the layout.

write.text: Optional local AI polishes translations and fixes your grammar, still on your PC.

outro.text: Owl-L. Free and open source. Download it on GitHub.
